svg.title: Autonomous research, from ideas to evidence
svg.desc: The Owner gives goals, constraints and budget. A Master agent plans, coordinates and supervises parallel research agents (literature, code and methods, simulations, analysis, verification, ideas); agent sessions are disposable. Workers use and improve a versioned research harness of methods, scripts, verifiers and workflows, submit jobs to HPC/Slurm, and results flow into a persistent Quest Board. An independent Reviewer reviews together with the Master. The Owner asks to be caught up, receives results with full context, and iterates on new questions and directions.
svg.text: Autonomous research, from ideas to evidence
Agents work in parallel. Methods evolve. Research state persists. Human-in-the-loop.
Improve tools(PRs, new scripts, analysis, verifiers …)

g.text: Evolve on the fly, keep provenance.

svg.text: Iterate on new questions and directions
